strings.text: Night Flight

One night in the office of the night mail at the edge of a great field. Three mail planes are coming in from the south, the west and the north; when all three are down, the European mail goes north. You are Rivière, the director, who forgives no one — neither his men nor the weather; and tonight Fabien's Patagonian mail flies into a storm and does not come back. Whom will you forgive, what will you tell his wife, whom will you give the last minute of the line — and will you let the next plane go? What may one pay for a work that will outlive men — and may one pay with other men's lives and other people's grief?
strings.translation: 大機場邊緣，夜間郵務辦公室裡的一夜。三架郵機從南方、西方和北方飛來；三架都降落之後，歐洲郵機就要往北起飛。你是里維耶，航線主任，他誰也不原諒——不原諒他的人，也不原諒天氣；而今夜，法比安的巴塔哥尼亞郵機飛進了暴風雨，再也沒有回來。你會原諒誰？你要對他的妻子說什麼？你要把航線上的最後一分鐘給誰？你會讓下一架飛機起飛嗎？為了一項比人更長久的事業，可以付出什麼——又能不能用別人的性命和別人的悲傷來付？

strings.text: A night mail, a storm in the south, a wife at the door — and a director who never says he is sorry.
strings.translation: 一架夜間郵機、南方的暴風雨、門口的妻子——還有一個從來不說「我很遺憾」的主任。

strings.text: after the novel by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
strings.translation: 改編自安東尼・聖修伯里的小說

strings.text: The Andes
Pellerin’s shoulder
You touched his shoulder — Pellerin turned round
strings.translation: 你碰了碰他的肩膀——佩勒蘭轉過身來

strings.text: You walked past — “Report to Robineau”
strings.translation: 你走了過去——「報告交給羅比諾」

strings.text: The fine
You gave the fine to Robineau — the form went into his pocket
strings.translation: 你把罰單交給羅比諾——單子進了他的口袋

strings.text: You signed it yourself — “Thank you, sir”
strings.translation: 你親自簽了——「謝謝您，主任」

strings.text: You tore up the fine — the mechanics looked at one another
strings.translation: 你撕了罰單——技工們面面相覷

strings.text: Roblet
You dismissed Roblet — he went across the field
strings.translation: 你開除了羅布萊——他穿過機場走了

strings.text: You gave him back his box — “Twice”
strings.translation: 你把工具箱還給他——「兩遍」

strings.text: You took his spanner — “Better you had fired me”
strings.translation: 你拿走了他的扳手——「還不如開除我」

strings.text: Fine. A bit of a breeze
The ridge like a wall — and me under it, like a fly under the ceiling
strings.translation: 山脊像一堵牆——我就在它底下，像天花板下的一隻蒼蠅

strings.text: Touch his shoulder
His hands are shaking. Nobody is looking.
strings.translation: 他的手在發抖。沒有人在看。

strings.text: Report to Robineau
I asked him to supper tonight. He said yes
strings.translation: 我約了他今晚一起吃晚飯。他答應了

strings.text: The fine
Forty minutes… The Andes…
“You will sign it, Robineau”
“I will sign it myself”
Tear it up
You will sign it, Robineau. You are the inspector. You are not his friend
strings.translation: 羅比諾，你來簽。你是督察。你不是他的朋友

strings.text: Give it to him from me
Thank you, sir
He stops short — there is nothing to thank him for —, blushes, and puts the form away.
strings.translation: 他話說到一半停住——根本沒什麼好謝的——紅了臉，把單子收起來。

strings.text: You… but you never…
Go to your supper
The nut on the petrol pipe of the Asunción mail. Not locked. The plane came down at night in a field. The pilot unhurt. Lucky
strings.translation: 亞松森郵機汽油管上的螺帽。沒有鎖緊。飛機夜裡迫降在田裡。飛行員沒受傷。運氣好

strings.text: Twenty years, sir. The first engines here — my hands. I… one nut…
strings.translation: 二十年了，主任。這裡最早的引擎——都是我這雙手。我……就一個螺帽……

strings.text: Rivière looked at his hands. He thought that he could keep him
strings.translation: 里維耶看著他的手。他想，他是可以留下他的

strings.text: Dismiss him
Keep him on the engines
Take him off the engines
Robineau blots it. It is signed.
strings.translation: 羅比諾用吸墨紙壓了壓。簽好了。

strings.text: I am not dismissing you. I am dismissing the mistake
strings.translation: 我開除的不是你。是那個錯誤

strings.text: I understand
The European mail is yours tonight. You will check it twice
strings.translation: 今晚的歐洲郵機交給你。你檢查兩遍

strings.text: Twice
Sir… you?
Not the engines. The field: the chocks, the store
strings.translation: 引擎不行。去機場：輪擋、倉庫

strings.text: Better you had fired me
Trelew: land?
No. We’ll outrun it
The Storm
The telephone
You told her: the wind — “Thank you. Forgive me”
strings.translation: 你告訴她：是風——「謝謝您。對不起」

strings.text: You told her the truth — “I am coming”
strings.translation: 你告訴她實話——「我這就過來」

strings.text: You gave the receiver away — Robineau did not raise his eyes
strings.translation: 你把聽筒交了出去——羅比諾沒有抬眼

strings.text: Asunción: landed
Sorry for the old man
And I sat in that field an hour, thinking — that’s it
strings.translation: 我在那片田裡坐了一個鐘頭，心想——完了

strings.text: Roblet on the engines?
Well. You know best
Saw him with the chocks. He put the chocks under me
strings.translation: 看見他在搬輪擋。是他替我墊的輪擋

strings.text: He didn’t look at me
Trelew: storm from the south. Field closed
strings.translation: 特雷利烏：南方來的暴風雨。機場關閉

strings.text: Comodoro: wind eighty. No contact with Fabien for fifteen minutes
strings.translation: 科莫多羅：風速八十。和法比安失去聯絡十五分鐘了

strings.text: All stations listen for Fabien. Bearing on request. Hold the European until he comes in
strings.translation: 所有電臺收聽法比安。依請求測向。歐洲郵機等他到了再放行

strings.text: Trelew closed. Comodoro closed. Where to?
strings.translation: 特雷利烏關閉。科莫多羅關閉。去哪裡？

strings.text: I don’t know
He no longer knew whether he was over land
strings.translation: 他再也不知道自己是不是在陸地上空

strings.text: I gave him the form. Over the soup. He signed it and went off to bed
strings.translation: 我把單子交給他了。喝湯的時候。他簽了字，就回去睡了

strings.text: The soup was good
He saw your signature and said: the old man is right
strings.translation: 他看見您的簽名，說：老頭說得對

strings.text: Then all through supper — about the Andes. And about you
strings.translation: 後來整頓晚飯都在講安地斯山。還有講您

strings.text: He paid for both of us. He said: another time — when you have no papers with you
strings.translation: 他付了兩個人的帳。他說：下次吧——等你沒帶公文的時候

strings.text: He didn’t believe it. He asked: did I look that bad?
strings.translation: 他不相信。他問：我的樣子真有那麼糟嗎？

strings.text: And he asked too… whether the old man is ill
strings.translation: 他還問……老頭是不是病了

strings.text: Madame Fabien
Forgive me for… We have such a wind here. He said — by two. He hasn’t come down somewhere to wait it out?
strings.translation: 對不起，我……我們這裡風好大。他說過——兩點以前。他是不是在哪裡降落，等風過去？

strings.text: “He is delayed. The wind”
“He is in the storm. We are listening for him”
strings.translation: 「他在暴風雨裡。我們正在收聽他」

strings.text: Hold out the receiver to Robineau
He is delayed. The wind
Thank you. Forgive me
He is in the storm. We are listening for him
strings.translation: 他在暴風雨裡。我們正在收聽他

strings.text: I am coming
The wind, madame… the line is bad… don’t you worry…
strings.translation: 是風，太太……線路不好……您別擔心……

strings.text: The Stars
The last minute
You gave the minute to the bearing — the flag in the sea
strings.translation: 你把那一分鐘給了測向——小旗插在海上

strings.text: You gave it to her words — “To her: I see a light”
strings.translation: 你把它給了她的話——「給她：我看見光了」

strings.text: You gave it to your own — “To Rivière: understood. To her”
strings.translation: 你把它給了你自己的話——「給里維耶：收到。給她」

strings.text: Robineau
You said “Get to work” — Robineau sat down to his report
strings.translation: 你說「去工作」——羅比諾坐下來寫報告

strings.text: You sat down beside Robineau — the telegraph was silent
strings.translation: 你在羅比諾身旁坐下——電報機一片沉默

strings.text: You turned away to the map — Robineau went out onto the field alone
strings.translation: 你轉身面向地圖——羅比諾一個人走到機場上

strings.text: You told the truth. I couldn’t stay at home
strings.translation: 您說了實話。我在家待不住

strings.text: Two o’clock. He hasn’t come. I was told — the wind…
strings.translation: 兩點了。他沒有回來。有人跟我說——是風……

strings.text: Two o’clock. He hasn’t come. You said — the wind
strings.translation: 兩點了。他沒有回來。您說——是風

strings.text: I am in your way. I will stand here. I won’t be in the way
strings.translation: 我妨礙你們了。我就站在這裡。我不會礙事的

strings.text: Madame, all the stations are listening for him
strings.translation: 太太，所有電臺都在收聽他

strings.text: Before him stood another truth — a lamp, a table laid for two o’clock. And he had nothing to set against it
strings.translation: 在他面前站著另一種真理——一盞燈，一張為兩點鐘擺好的餐桌。而他拿不出任何東西來反駁

strings.text: We see nothing. Trying to climb. Fuel for thirty minutes
strings.translation: 什麼都看不見。試著爬升。燃料還夠三十分鐘

strings.text: We see nothing. Trying to climb. Fuel for thirty minutes
strings.translation: 什麼都看不見。試著爬升。燃料還夠三十分鐘

strings.text: Comodoro: we catch him every other time. A gap — perhaps a minute. We ask for him under bearing, for the search: the key held in one long tone, the lines silent. Give him no words: if he answers, there will be no tone
strings.translation: 科莫多羅：時斷時續收得到他。有一個空檔——也許一分鐘。我們請他發測向訊號，好去搜尋：按住電鍵發一個長音，各線路保持靜默。別發文字給他：他要是回答，就不會有長音了

strings.text: The service: the bearing
Her words
My own
Nothing, sir? Then by the service. Comodoro — bearing
strings.translation: 沒有指示嗎，主任？那就照規定。科莫多羅——測向

strings.text: Comodoro — bearing. The rest, silence
strings.translation: 科莫多羅——測向。其他人保持靜默

strings.text: What shall we send?
That I haven’t gone to bed. I am waiting
Sir… on the service line?
Send it
To Fabien. The whole line is listening to you. Your wife is here. Rivière
strings.translation: 給法比安。整條航線都在聽你。你的妻子在這裡。里維耶

strings.text: Comodoro: hold the key. Bearing
strings.translation: 科莫多羅：按住電鍵。測向

strings.text: From your wife: not gone to bed. Waiting
Rivière: the whole line is listening to you. Your wife is here
strings.translation: 里維耶：整條航線都在聽你。你的妻子在這裡

strings.text: To her: I see a light
To Rivière: understood. To her —
He knew that from this beauty there was no coming back. And still he climbed
strings.translation: 他知道，從這片美裡是回不去了。但他還是往上爬

strings.text: Beautiful
Comodoro: bearing taken. By bearing and reckoning — over the sea, a hundred and fifty east of Trelew
strings.translation: 科莫多羅：測向完成。根據測向和推算——在海上，特雷利烏以東一百五十公里

strings.text: To her: I see a light
To Rivière: understood. To her
Comodoro: no bearing. There was no tone
strings.translation: 科莫多羅：沒能測向。沒有長音

strings.text: He is sending something. I can’t make it out
By the fuel… that’s all
Once he had watched a bridge being built, and asked himself: is a bridge worth one crushed face? And he found no answer
strings.translation: 有一次，他看著人們造橋，問自己：一座橋，值得一張被壓碎的臉嗎？他找不到答案

strings.text: Robineau. Take madame to my office
strings.translation: 羅比諾。帶太太到我的辦公室

strings.text: Can one see the field from there?
One can
“Get to work, Robineau”
“Sit down”
Say nothing
Get to work, Robineau
Sit down
The European Mail
The European mail
You raised your hand — the lights went north
strings.translation: 你舉起手——燈光往北而去

strings.text: You said “stand down” — the floodlights went out
strings.translation: 你說「取消」——探照燈熄滅了

strings.text: You said nothing — “Since you say nothing — by the timetable”
strings.translation: 你什麼也沒說——「既然您不說話——就照時刻表」

strings.text: Checked it twice
Who checked it?
I did. Roblet’s gone
They said to hold it till he came in
The south is closed. By three the storm will be here
strings.translation: 南方關閉了。三點以前暴風雨就會到這裡

strings.text: One more… this same night…
strings.translation: 又一個……就在同一個晚上……

strings.text: Ready, sir
Ready. Ready a long time
strings.translation: 準備好了。早就準備好了

strings.text: Raise his hand: fly
“Stand down. Till dawn”
Two fifty-two
Stand down. Till dawn
Stand down? You?
Till dawn, sir
To the board… shall I write?
I will myself
Because of me?
No
He won’t come now
Since you say nothing — by the timetable
strings.translation: 既然您不說話——就照時刻表

strings.text: Gone
Will they go there?
The launches from Trelew. At dawn
strings.translation: 特雷利烏的汽艇。天一亮就去

strings.text: I will go to Trelew
He saw a light
Is it lights? Did he land?
strings.translation: 那是燈光嗎？他降落了嗎？

strings.text: I will be at home
He began — to me. What comes next?
strings.translation: 他開了頭——是給我的。後面是什麼？

strings.text: It could not be made out
Rivière blots it himself.
strings.translation: 里維耶親手用吸墨紙壓了壓。

strings.text: Below, in the rain, Roblet stands by the hangar.
strings.translation: 樓下，雨中，羅布萊站在機庫旁。

strings.text: Below, in the rain, Roblet is gathering up the chocks.
strings.translation: 樓下，雨中，羅布萊在收拾輪擋。

strings.text: Below, under the lamp by the hangar, Roblet’s empty workbench in the rain.
strings.translation: 樓下，機庫旁的燈下，羅布萊空空的工作台淋著雨。

strings.text: I am here, sir
In the window: he is still by the hangar wall, in the rain, without his coat.
strings.translation: 窗外：他還站在機庫牆邊，淋著雨，沒穿大衣。

strings.text: Rivière the Great, Rivière the Conqueror, bearing his heavy victory
strings.translation: 偉大的里維耶，勝利者里維耶，背負著他沉重的勝利

strings.text: Robineau is not here: he went home without a word.
strings.translation: 羅比諾不在：他一句話也沒說就回家了。

strings.text: Trelew: the launches are back. On the water, by the point of the bearing — a patch of oil. Nothing more
strings.translation: 特雷利烏：汽艇回來了。在水面上，測向的那個點旁邊——有一片油跡。別的什麼也沒有

strings.text: The search along the line: nothing
strings.translation: 沿航線搜尋：什麼也沒有

strings.text: Madame Fabien telephoned. She asks whether they have found him
strings.translation: 法比安太太打電話來了。她問找到他了沒有

strings.text: Forgive me
All by the clock, sir
Good
I seem to have caught a cold…
Get to work
The fine for Pellerin — into the orders?
strings.translation: 佩勒蘭的罰單——列入命令嗎？

strings.text: Into the orders
They are asking about last night… was it just once?
strings.translation: 他們在問昨晚的事……那只是一次嗎？

strings.text: Once
They are asking: are the rules now — as they were last night?
strings.translation: 他們在問：現在的規定——就像昨晚那樣嗎？

strings.text: European: passed Montevideo on time
strings.translation: 歐洲郵機：準時通過蒙特維多

strings.text: Patagonian: passed San Julián. Sky clear
strings.translation: 巴塔哥尼亞郵機：通過聖胡利安。天空晴朗

strings.text: Release the Patagonian?
strings.translation: 巴塔哥尼亞郵機放行嗎？

strings.text: Release
Night flights suspended pending inquiry
strings.translation: 夜間飛行暫停，等候調查

strings.text: The director to submit explanations of the departures from the rules last night
strings.translation: 請主任就昨夜違反規定一事提出說明

strings.text: The mail went by day. The night was nobody’s again
strings.translation: 郵件改在白天飛了。黑夜又變得不屬於任何人

strings.text: Dusk
Below, the windows were lighting up. In each of them someone was waiting
strings.translation: 下面，窗戶一扇扇亮起。每一扇窗裡，都有人在等待

strings.text: San Julián. Sky clear
On the map two more flags are in the air — over the Andes, and over the river in the north; the red one, the European mail’s, stands at the field.
strings.translation: 地圖上還有兩面小旗在空中——一面在安地斯山上空，一面在北方的河上；紅色的那面，歐洲郵機的，立在機場上。

strings.text: Three in the air
The board asks whether the night flights should not be suspended till spring. After last winter
strings.translation: 董事會詢問，夜間飛行是不是該暫停到春天。經過去年冬天之後

strings.text: They will not close the night until I close it myself
strings.translation: 除非我自己關掉黑夜，否則誰也關不掉它

strings.text: The Chilean mail is late. Pellerin ran into a storm over the Andes. By the rule — a fine for being late
strings.translation: 智利郵機誤點了。佩勒蘭在安地斯山上空遇到了暴風雨。照規定——誤點要罰款

strings.text: By the rule
And… Madame Fabien telephoned. She asked us to tell her husband she will not go to bed till he comes
strings.translation: 還有……法比安太太打電話來。她請我們轉告她先生，他不回來，她就不睡

strings.text: The line is for the service
That is what I told her
Roblet is waiting by the hangar. The order is ready
strings.translation: 羅布萊在機庫旁等著。命令已經準備好了

strings.text: If you keep it, the chapters after this one will have to be played again.
strings.translation: 如果保留這個選擇，這一章之後的章節都得重玩一遍。

“Patagonian: passed San Julián. Sky clear.” The blue flag goes up the south line, to San Julián.
strings.translation: 「巴塔哥尼亞郵機：通過聖胡利安。天空晴朗。」藍色小旗沿著南線上行，到聖胡利安。

strings.text: “Asunción: landed.” The northern flag comes home to the field.
strings.translation: 「亞松森：已降落。」北線的小旗回到了機場。

strings.text: By the bearing — over the sea, a hundred and fifty east of Trelew. She watches where he puts it.
strings.translation: 根據測向——在海上，特雷利烏以東一百五十公里。她看著他把旗子插在哪裡。

strings.text: The telegraphist counts the fuel under his breath, minute by minute. Rivière’s finger on the blue flag by Trelew.
strings.translation: 電報員低聲一分一分地算著燃油。里維耶的手指按在特雷利烏旁的藍色小旗上。

strings.text: The red flag at the field; the line north.
strings.translation: 紅色小旗在機場上；航線向北。

strings.text: “Patagonian: passed San Julián. Sky clear.” The same knock as yesterday.
strings.translation: 「巴塔哥尼亞郵機：通過聖胡利安。天空晴朗。」和昨天一樣的敲擊聲。

strings.text: “Release.” Yesterday’s red flag, still at the field.
strings.translation: 「放行。」昨天的紅色小旗，還在機場上。

strings.text: Dawn, grey. The inker is silent. The red flag comes off the map, into the drawer.
strings.translation: 灰濛濛的黎明。收報機沉默著。紅色小旗離開地圖，收進抽屜。

strings.text: Too quick — the flag fell. Rivière picks it up.
strings.translation: 太快了——小旗掉了。里維耶把它撿起來。

strings.text: The order lies on the packed tool box; the pen in Rivière’s hand.
strings.translation: 命令放在收拾好的工具箱上；筆在里維耶手中。

strings.text: Too quick — a blot.
The log open under the lamp; rain on the glass. One line for Fabien.
strings.translation: 燈下攤開的日誌；雨打在玻璃上。為法比安寫的一行。

strings.text: Twenty past ten. Over the dark field the drone of an engine, lower and lower; Rivière’s hand on the switch.
strings.translation: 十點二十分。漆黑的機場上空，引擎聲越來越低；里維耶的手放在電閘上。

strings.text: Too quick — the switch jams; a mechanic finishes pulling it.
strings.translation: 太快了——電閘卡住了；一個技工幫忙推到底。

strings.text: Ten to three. The European mail under the hangar’s lamps, its engine warming; the field behind it dark.
strings.translation: 差十分三點。歐洲航班停在機庫燈下，引擎正在暖機；它身後的機場一片漆黑。

strings.text: The field lit to its edge, the plane ready. The same switch, the same hand.
strings.translation: 機場一直亮到盡頭，飛機已經就緒。同一個電閘，同一隻手。

strings.text: Too quick — the switch jams; Robineau finishes pulling it.
strings.translation: 太快了——電閘卡住了；羅比諾幫忙拉到底。

strings.text: The Box
Twenty years of tools, packed. Rivière holds the box out.
strings.translation: 二十年的工具，收進了箱子。里維耶把箱子遞出去。

strings.text: Roblet’s hand is on the handle.
strings.translation: 羅布萊的手握住了提把。

strings.text: Roblet takes the box himself.
The Chocks
Rivière’s hand raised. The engine runs up.
strings.translation: 里維耶的手舉著。引擎加速運轉。

strings.text: The engine at its full roar.
The mechanic signs to the pilot; the plane moves off by itself.
strings.translation: 技工向飛行員打了手勢；飛機自己滑出去了。

strings.text: Up
The minute is over. Overhead, in the gap, the stars.
strings.translation: 那一分鐘過去了。頭頂的雲縫裡，有星星。

strings.text: Too sharp. Fabien drags it up himself, with a jerk.
strings.translation: 太猛了。法比安自己猛地一拉，把飛機拉上去。

strings.text: Too quick — the flag slid off the line.
strings.translation: 太快了——小旗滑出了航線。

strings.text: The Flag
The finger slipped; the flag rocked and stayed where it was.
strings.translation: 手指滑開了；小旗晃了晃，停在原處。

strings.text: The Light
The Pen
The Spanner
Rivière’s palm under the spanner; Roblet’s fingers are slow to open.
strings.translation: 里維耶的手掌托在扳手下；羅布萊的手指遲遲才鬆開。

strings.text: The palm came back too soon. Roblet lays the spanner on the workbench himself.
strings.translation: 手掌收得太早了。羅布萊自己把扳手放到工作台上。

strings.text: The spanner is in Rivière’s palm.
strings.translation: 扳手落在里維耶的掌心。

strings.text: The Stick
Darkness and lightning; the plane is thrown about, and Fabien holds it level.
strings.translation: 黑暗與閃電；飛機被拋來拋去，法比安讓它保持平穩。

strings.text: Over on a wing — and water below, in the lightning. Fabien rights it.
strings.translation: 側翻了——閃電中，下面是水。法比安把飛機扳正。

strings.text: The Tape
The inker comes to life. Fabien’s words, one by one.
strings.translation: 收報機動了起來。法比安的話，一個字一個字。

strings.text: Too quick — the tape runs out by itself.
strings.translation: 太快了——紙帶自己跑完了。

Rivière
Fabien
Madame Fabien
Pellerin
the radio operator

Exceptions
not one
the rule bends
The rule bent before everyone
strings.translation: 規定當著大家的面彎了

strings.text: Exceptions: how many times tonight the rule has bent before everyone. Nought — not one; one; two or three — the rule bends.
strings.translation: 例外：今夜規定當著大家的面彎了幾次。零——一次也沒有；一次；兩三次——規定彎了。

strings.text: What she was told
the wind
the storm
She was told: the storm
What she knows: what she was told on the telephone — the wind or the storm; and, later, what is left her of the last minute.
strings.translation: 她知道什麼：電話裡告訴她的——是風，還是暴風雨；以及後來，那最後一分鐘給她留下了什麼。

strings.text: Of the last minute
the place
his word
“To her —”, without an end
You touched his shoulder. Pellerin turned round.
strings.translation: 你碰了碰他的肩膀。佩勒蘭轉過身來。

strings.text: Robineau signed the fine and put it in his pocket. He is taking it to supper.
strings.translation: 羅比諾簽了罰單，放進口袋。他帶著它去吃晚飯。

strings.text: You signed the fine yourself. “Thank you, sir.”
strings.translation: 你親自簽了罰單。「謝謝您，主任。」

strings.text: You tore up the fine before the mechanics. They looked at one another.
strings.translation: 你當著技工們的面撕了罰單。他們面面相覷。

strings.text: Roblet is dismissed. He went across the field with his box.
strings.translation: 羅布萊被開除了。他提著工具箱穿過機場走了。

strings.text: Roblet stays on the engines. “Twice.”
strings.translation: 羅布萊繼續管引擎。「兩遍。」

strings.text: Roblet is taken off the engines: the chocks, the store. “Better you had fired me.”
strings.translation: 羅布萊不再碰引擎：輪擋、倉庫。「還不如開除我。」

strings.text: You told her: the wind.
You gave the receiver to Robineau. He told her: the wind — and did not raise his eyes.
strings.translation: 你把聽筒交給羅比諾。他告訴她：是風——沒有抬眼。

strings.text: The minute went to the bearing. Nobody will read his last words.
strings.translation: 那一分鐘給了測向。他最後的話，沒有人會讀到。

strings.text: Her words went down the service line. There will be no bearing.
strings.translation: 她的話透過公務線路發了出去。不會有測向了。

strings.text: You signed your name. The director never signs.
strings.translation: 你署了名。主任從來不署名。

strings.text: “Get to work, Robineau.” He sat down to his report.
strings.translation: 「去工作吧，羅比諾。」他坐下來寫報告。

strings.text: Robineau will remember.
Robineau went out onto the field alone, without his coat.
strings.translation: 羅比諾一個人走到機場上，沒穿大衣。

strings.text: You raised your hand. The lights went north.
strings.translation: 你舉起手。燈光往北而去。

strings.text: You said “stand down”. The floodlights went out.
strings.translation: 你說了「取消」。探照燈熄滅了。

strings.text: You said nothing. “Since you say nothing — by the timetable.”
strings.translation: 你什麼也沒說。「既然您不說話——就照時刻表。」
